LowPowerCoolingCapacity.definition: Cooling capacity of a low-powered air conditioner (number of housing units it can cool)

LowPowerElectricityUsage.definition: Electricity usage of a low-powered air conditioner (units per day)

HighPowerCoolingCapacity.definition: Cooling capacity of a high-powered air conditioner (number of housing units it can cool)

HighPowerElectricityUsage.definition: Electricity usage of a high-powered air conditioner (units per day)

MaxLowPowerPercentage.definition: Maximum percentage of low-powered air conditioners allowed

MinHighPowerModels.definition: Minimum number of high-powered air conditioners required

TotalCoolingRequired.definition: Total number of housing units to be cooled
